title: Sharing a folder
intro: Share a folder when someone needs more than one file. Create a link anyone can open, or send it to named people.

sections.heading: Open the folder's Share window
steps: Point to the folder, then click the **Share** icon on its row.
sections.tip: You can also click the folder's checkbox, then click **Share** in the selection bar.
sections.note: If you own or manage the library, the window also has **People and groups** at the top. It works the same way as in “Sharing a whole library”.

sections.heading: Create a link anyone can open
text: Use **Anyone with the link** for one link to hand around. It only shows the files in the folder right now, not ones you add later.
steps: Under **Anyone with the link**, choose how long it lasts under **Expires**.
Add a **Password** if you want one.
Click **Create link**. Depot copies the link so you can paste it anywhere.

sections.heading: Send it to named people
text: Use **Send to people** when you know who needs the folder. They always see its newest files, including ones you add later.
steps: Under **Send to people**, type each email address and press Enter.
Under **Expires**, choose how long the link should work.
Add a **Password** if the files are sensitive, and a **Note** to say why you sent them.
Turn on **Let them add files to this folder** if they should send files back.
Click **Send to 1**. The number is how many people you added.
sections.note: Colleagues sign in to open the folder. Anyone else can open the link without signing in, so add a password if it must not be passed on. To stop any folder link working, click **Revoke** next to it in this window.
